title: build_argument skill — structure a persuasive argument/rebuttal for a debater's side (Epic 4)
prompt:
Implement build_argument(...) that helps a debater structure a persuasive argument or rebuttal for its assigned side (claim, support, link to opponent's point). Register as a Pydantic AI tool with validated inputs.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: First agent skill of Epic 4 (PRD §5.2). Created the core/skills/ subpackage mirroring the search/gatekeeper layout: skills/models.py (validated I/O models) + skills/build_argument.py (the function) + skills/__init__.py (re-export), with agent_debate.core re-exporting ArgumentRequest, Argument, DebateSide, build_argument. INPUT model ArgumentRequest (frozen, extra='forbid'): side: DebateSide (a StrEnum pro/con so a bad value fails ValidationError), claim (non-empty after trim), supports: list[str] (min_length=1; a field validator trims entries, drops blanks, and rejects an all-blank list), optional opponent_point. OUTPUT model Argument (frozen, extra='forbid'): side, claim, normalised supports, optional rebuttal, and a conclusion; round-trips through JSON. PURE/NO-NETWORK skill: build_argument deterministically STRUCTURES the agent-supplied content into the typed Argument and makes NO LLM/network call — the LLM provides the content as tool arguments and the skill arranges it — so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) requirement is N/A here (noted per task). Anti-sycophancy (docs/prds/anti-sycophancy.md §2/§3): when opponent_point is supplied, the rebuttal quotes and explicitly contests it (lead-in 'The opponent argued: ' + lead-out ' — this does not hold, because:') rather than restating/conceding. No hard-coded values: REBUTTAL_LEAD_IN/REBUTTAL_LEAD_OUT/CONCLUSION_TEMPLATE live in constants.py. Emits an optional 'tool_call' debug line via the LOG package (no run_id needed for a pure call). Tool-readiness: validated-input function + Pydantic input/output models; FULL Pydantic AI tool registration is task 4.5 (not over-built here). TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_build_argument.py (10 tests: structured output fields, side reflected, opponent_point produces a rebuttal link, JSON round-trip, and ValidationError on empty/whitespace claim, bad side enum value, missing required field, empty supports list, and all-blank supports; plus supports normalisation), watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'Argument'), then implemented to green. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed (switched DebateSide to enum.StrEnum per UP042); ruff format --check . clean; mypy = no issues in 85 source files; pytest --cov = 305 passed, 100% coverage on the new skills subpackage, 99.66% total (>=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0 (models.py ~42 code lines, build_argument.py ~16, both well under 150); secret_scan.py rc=0. docs/PROMPTS.md entry added.
